title: Implement Kokoro-82M TTS backend
description: Implement real lazy-loaded Kokoro-82M inference in worker-image and CLI, register both backends, and add runtime dependencies and espeak-ng. Acceptance: requested CLI and worker-image formatting, lint, and pytest checks pass.
